title: Everyday Phrases — A Morning Run
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏃 實用晨跑必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Morning Run
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用晨跑情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從鬧鐘不想起、約門口見、熱身拉筋、配速呼吸，到衝刺收操、洗澡早餐，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Morning Run phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from hitting the alarm and meeting at the gate to warming up, pacing, breathing, cooling down and breakfast. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it goes off at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is too early for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe move it to six thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, so hard to rise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed feels so warm now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But we promised a morning run.
dialogue.zh: 但我們答應了要晨跑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the gate near your house?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just a two minute walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will wait out front.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not be late again today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the weather like today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it going to rain later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rain, the sky is blue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 早晨的空氣感覺冷冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it warms up soon.
dialogue.zh: 帶吧，不過一下子就會變暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is only two degrees out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is cold for running weather.
dialogue.zh: 對跑步的天氣來說太冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gloves keep my hands really warm.
dialogue.zh: 手套能讓我的手暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 帶你那副薄的跑步手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hat keeps my ears warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, wear the bright one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is not up yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we need our running lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clip the light to your shirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine already points at the road.
dialogue.zh: 我的那盞已經照著路面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear the vest that reflects light.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shiny one keeps us safe.
dialogue.zh: 亮亮的那件能保護我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cars can see us in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrz kæn si ʌs ɪn ðə dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 車子才能在暗處看到我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a headlamp too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These are my new running shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do they fit your feet well?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear thick socks, not thin ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 薄襪子一下就磨出水泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These socks go up to my knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz sɑks ɡoʊ ʌp tə maɪ niz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那種襪對疲勞的腿有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not run in cotton shirts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pack a light jacket.
dialogue.zh: 我會塞一件輕外套進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很適合我們的跑步路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quick wash wakes me up.
dialogue.zh: 快速洗一把臉就清醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I drank a glass of water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 通常自己跑，但今天比較好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you sleep last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I even dreamed about running.
dialogue.zh: 睡得不錯，還夢到在跑步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is twenty past six now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time to go, grab your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go get it, I will wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready to go out?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 日出前是一天最暗的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your phone in a pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you carry your house key?
dialogue.zh: 你會隨身帶家門鑰匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep one in my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's not run on the road.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first run always feels big.
dialogue.zh: 第一次跑總是感覺很隆重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the gate soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am not cold anymore now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This feels good on my neck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swing one leg front and back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, my hips really need this.
dialogue.zh: 喔，我的髖部也正需要動一動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 髖部對正確的跑姿很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: March in place, lift those knees.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 高踢腿讓腿後側鬆一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Side steps open up the hips.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 準備好了嗎？我們慢慢開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 慢速是我最喜歡的配速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say stop, and I will stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we keep an easy pace?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以維持輕鬆的配速嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，用能講話的速度跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I cannot talk, I am too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈkænɑt tɔk, aɪ æm tu fæst./
dialogue.zh: 如果我講不出話，就是跑太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull air in through your nose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out for two steps as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 穩定的節奏可以省體力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe out on the hard parts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast songs make me speed up.
dialogue.zh: 快歌會讓我忍不住加速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick calm ones for easy days.
dialogue.zh: 輕鬆的日子就挑溫和的歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it low, hear the cars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No music today, hear the birds.
dialogue.zh: 今天不聽音樂，聽小鳥叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 真好，公園聽起來很安寧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the phone deep in a pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə foʊn dip ɪn ə ˈpɑkɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 跑步時大家都喘得很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This path is flat and wide.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很適合找出我們的節奏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel light on my feet.
dialogue.zh: 我腳步輕盈得像要飛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這就是晨跑的美妙感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the sky is turning pink.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chin up, eyes on the path.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One down, we are doing great.
dialogue.zh: 第一公里搞定，我們狀況很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not look at your watch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一直看時間會讓跑得更久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I will hide my watch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bridge has a nice view.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The river shines in the sun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold air makes my nose run.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wiped it on my sleeve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a few words at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə fju wɜrdz æt ə taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more lap around the lake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the birds keep our beat.
dialogue.zh: 聽，小鳥在幫我們打拍子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It hurts when I breathe deep.
dialogue.zh: 我深呼吸的時候會刺痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less when you warm up well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一小口一小口喝，別猛灌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small sips, that is the trick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A water fountain is up ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，把我的水壺補滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water on a run is gold.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtər ɑn ə rʌn ɪz ɡoʊld./
dialogue.zh: 跑步時的一口冷水勝過黃金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上坡用走的是聰明做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not race down, easy knees.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, the app says we turned wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, ði æp sɛz wi tɜrnd rɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 等等，App 說我們轉錯彎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So back to the last corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它又抓到我們的位子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is left on the loop?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɪz lɛft ɑn ðə lup?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His owner walks him early too.
dialogue.zh: 牠的主人也很早帶牠散步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個慢跑的人對我們點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That lady walks this path daily.
dialogue.zh: 那位太太每天都走這條路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hi, morning runners are friends.
dialogue.zh: 打個招呼，晨跑的人都是朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 數數真的能騙過疲勞的大腦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, these legs feel like noodles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it really one more kilometer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app says one, keep going.
dialogue.zh: App 說一公里，繼續向前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 流汗的時候有風最救命。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shirt is dark with sweat.
dialogue.zh: 這件衣服被汗浸出一塊深色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就是今天努力的證據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bird flew past my head!
dialogue.zh: 一隻鳥擦過我的頭飛走！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 專心點，先跑完再吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 最後那個轉角感覺好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is closer than it feels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, my side hurts a little again.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm, maɪ saɪd hɜrts ə ˈlɪtəl əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我的側腹又有點痛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out on every third step.
dialogue.zh: 每踩第三步就吐一次氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 想走路休息隨時都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 走路其實也算一種訓練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is fully up now.
dialogue.zh: 太陽已經整個升起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 麵包店的香味實在太犯規。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my watch buzzed a warning.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, maɪ wɑtʃ bʌzd ə ˈwɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是晨跑者專用的天然香水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our route flat from here?
dialogue.zh: 從這裡開始我們的路線平嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, flat all the way home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小寶寶是最棒的啦啦隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 第二次呼吸，早晨的魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我現在總算像個活人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 剩下的部分就交給早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 漂亮地收尾，我們快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On my count, one, two, go!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？我的腿都沒力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 繼續走一走，讓身體降溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart is going so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will slow in one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的還在很大聲地打招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand and fold at the hips.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot touch mine at all.
dialogue.zh: 我根本碰不到我的腳尖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feel the stretch behind your legs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There it is, that tight pull.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 不要一下一下地彈，撐住就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的指尖差一點就碰到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stretch your calves on the step.
dialogue.zh: 在最後一階拉一下小腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小腿繃緊緊，明天的功課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you feel it in your ears?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju fil ɪt ɪn jʊr ɪrz?/
dialogue.zh: 你耳朵裡聽得到心跳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stairs are our last test.
dialogue.zh: 爬樓梯是最後一個考驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上兩層樓，然後徹底休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My key is in my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Home at last, drop your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You smell like a gym bag.
dialogue.zh: 你聞起來就像個運動包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣讓痠累的肩膀鬆開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 頭髮鹹鹹的，就是誠實的證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 跑完要換一身乾淨衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 汗濕的衣服就丟進洗衣籃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will make the coffee first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩顆糖，這是早晨的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我一坐下來腿就特別沉重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 先休息十分鐘，再好好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上面鋪香蕉，跑者的吃法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 再幫我的水杯倒滿好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一整個上午都補水和吃水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thighs ache when I sit.
dialogue.zh: 我的大腿一坐下去就痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是老老實實賺來的痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 明天同樣的鬧鐘、同樣的大門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will set it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的身體會原諒我們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 給它充足的睡眠和食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add it to my calendar.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æd ɪt tə maɪ ˈkæləndər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 先跑一次，才會有連續紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 連續紀錄都從一個早晨開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 明天走同一條路線，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, six thirty at the gate.
dialogue.zh: 一言為定，六點半門口見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的 App 存好今天的記錄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me the little map line.
dialogue.zh: 給我看那條小小的路線圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 傳過去了，快看你的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am proud of us today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天真為我們感到驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 先休息五分鐘，再做家事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 聰明，睡迷糊的我總會忘事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good run, see you at dawn.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 連做夢都夢到那條跑道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的身體贏得了這場休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好好休息，明天還在等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am so glad we went.
dialogue.zh: 真高興我們今天出門了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow you will be glad too.
dialogue.zh: 明天你也會感謝自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the gate then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 眼睛亮亮、雙腿痠痠，說定。
